verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a spending cap, budget limit, or budget alert for Cerebras Inference. The console is described only as managing "usage, billing" in general terms. Rate limits (TPM/RPM) and self-serve prepaid payment are adjacent controls that throttle throughput or fund the account; they are not a configurable spend ceiling or alert, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
